quotes.summary_phrase: Charlie Villanueva explains his draft strategy for Nikola Jokic
quotes.excerpt: Nikola Jokic is the ultimate floor-raising and ceiling-raising engine in basketball history.
quotes.quote: Nikola Jokic is the ultimate floor-raising and ceiling-raising engine in basketball history. He literally functions as the coach on the floor. Flanked by elite, low-maintenance self-creators and shooters like Kawhi Leonard, Jayson Tatum, Kyrie Irving, and Damian Lillard, this team requires zero complex play-calling to shred defenses.
